			current.setValue(prefix + '_country', loc.getValue('country'));
		}
	}

	var accountId = current.getValue('account');

	var billingLoc = getAddressLocation(accountId, BILLING_TYPE) || getAddressLocation(accountId, HQ_TYPE);
	var shippingLoc = getAddressLocation(accountId, SHIPPING_TYPE) || getAddressLocation(accountId, HQ_TYPE);

	applyLocation(billingLoc, 'billing');
	applyLocation(shippingLoc, 'shipping');
